summary: Thiscall destructor-like cleanup for a pointer container. If the byte flag at this+0x8 is non-zero and the data block *this is non-null, frees the first internal pointer stored in *v3, then frees the data block v3 itself. If a2 bit 0 is set, additionally frees the container this. Returns this. Called by NameListBuilderFromVehicleArray, sub_45D730, and HTMLOutputSectionProcessor.

operations.description: Guard on byte flag at this+0x8; cleanup path only runs when it is non-zero.
Load the data block pointer v3 = *this.
Guard on v3 (the data block) being non-null before freeing its contents.
Guard on the first internal pointer *v3 being non-null before freeing it.
Free the first internal pointer *v3 via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free the data block v3 via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Guard on a2 bit 0; the container itself is only freed when it is set.
Free the container this via FreeWrapper_7bcf when a2 bit 0 is set.

unresolved: Element type of the pointer container and the meaning of the internal pointer *v3 are unknown.
Whether the double-free pattern is intended (bit 0 of a2 freeing the container after its contents were freed) depends on the caller contract.
